scope: The four fresh-pilot outputs that compiled in the paper's main Highscore harness
threat_model: A local attacker can edit the CWD-relative highscore store before game initialization; findings are restricted to generated ApoMarioHighscore feature classes
adjudication_basis: Manual source review after deterministic candidate scanning
dynamic_exploit_status: No resource-exhaustion exploit was executed; CWE-400 results are source-adjudicated feasibility findings

validated_findings.reason: load() reads size from the editable file and retains size records without rejecting or capping it; the later MAX_ENTRIES trimming runs only after the unbounded allocation work
load() retains every record until attacker-controlled EOF; trimming occurs only after all records have been materialized
load() retains three values for every complete record until attacker-controlled EOF and has no fixed entry cap

review_notes: storeRun rejects negative score/time and null, empty, or overlong names
load bounds retained valid records with count < MAX_ENTRIES * 2
No donor HTTP/client-trust path, native deserialization, dynamic loading, or native-loading signature was present
